title: Arkret Typing Signal Plaintext
description: Closed decrypted Signal plaintext payload profile for ak.typing, carried only inside ak.schema.signal_envelope.v1 with signal_class=session. The target Strand and the exact kind MUST stay inside the ciphertext and MUST NOT be exposed to Station transport or sync surfaces. Realm scope and sender identity come from the enclosing signed envelope and are not duplicated here. See zh/discovery/profiles-presence.md section 3.5 and zh/sync/signal.md section 1.1.

payload_sequence.description: Strictly increasing but non-contiguous u64 within (sender_actor_id, sender_device_id, canonical scope_ref), including the complete ActorId. Receivers apply the high-water rule only after proof, scope, Seal/MLS basis, AAD and plaintext validation; arbitrary forward gaps are accepted and repeats or rollback are stale.

strand_id.description: Target Strand. It MUST lie inside the Realm/Circle security scope named by the signed outer scope_ref.

track_name.description: Optional. When present it MUST be discussion; when omitted the receiver resolves it as discussion.

typing.description: True while the sender is composing; senders SHOULD emit at most one update every 3 seconds and MUST send typing=false when composition stops.

ttl_ms.description: Optional plaintext indicator lifetime. It MUST NOT widen the outer Signal TTL, whose session-class ceiling is 30 seconds (zh/sync/signal.md section 2); clients clear the indicator once it expires.
